open-question.question: The "Codex manifest location" decision places the manifest template at scripts/hosts/codex/.codex-plugin/plugin.json rendered to the same relative path, while the "Codex install route" decision puts the plugin under plugins/cairn/ so the manifest lands at plugins/cairn/.codex-plugin/plugin.json, and templates render to their own relative path. Where does the Codex manifest template sit, and where in the committed hosts/codex/ tree does the manifest land?

The "Codex plugin-root literal" decision says the build stays unchanged, but the build's dangling-plugin-root check resolves every plugin-root reference against the host tree's root, and the "Codex install route" decision puts the plugin under plugins/cairn/, so every ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/ and ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/ reference in the Codex tree would name no file and fail the gate. How does the build validate plugin-root references for a host whose plugin root is a subdirectory of its tree?

The "Verification run mode" decision has the maintainer run "the one inline skill" by hand in an interactive Codex session, approving its git steps, but no decision names which skill; the README example, init-milestone-base-workflow, would do nothing useful in a verification workspace already seeded with a milestone. Which cairn skill does the interactive verification check run?

The live verification mixes runner-executed checks (the plugin install and two headless agent dispatches) with one check the maintainer must run by hand in an interactive session, and a headless complete-all-tasks run has no one to pause for. How is the maintainer's interactive check placed relative to the task list?

CONTRIBUTING.md (## Development) and SECURITY.md each say "both" hosts or repositories and name the two, but neither appears in the Goal's release-ready surface list nor in any decision. Do they gain Codex wording in this milestone?
